rec.name: Cart Free-Shipping Progress Bar

what.text: A progress bar ('Shipping-Bar') in the cart that shows how close the customer is to the free-shipping threshold. The ticket description is empty, so the exact layout, copy and threshold logic are not documented. Comments only confirm the bar was built, looks good and works.

why.text: The goal-gradient effect: people speed up as they get closer to a visible goal. Showing the remaining amount turns shipping cost into a concrete, achievable target, which encourages adding items and raises AOV. Reaching the goal also gives positive feedback and reduces shipping-cost abandonment.

how.text: Compare the cart total (in cents) with a configurable free-shipping threshold. Render a progress bar plus a message such as 'Only €X left for free shipping', and switch to a success message once the threshold is reached. Update the bar live when quantities change or items are removed (AJAX cart events or section re-rendering). The actual implementation is not documented in the ticket.

items: Message copy before and after the threshold is reached
Show/hide when the cart is empty
Optional: exclude gift cards or specific products from the total

dependencies.text: Not specified in the ticket. Likely needs the cart template or cart drawer, a shipping threshold that matches the real Shopify shipping rate, and JS that listens to cart updates. If multi-currency or multi-market is used, thresholds per market are needed.

items: Share of orders at or above the free-shipping threshold
